name: @argszero/cordis-plugin-length-stop-overflow
description: Overflow guard for dsh: observes the llm/stream waterfall and restores the CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED classification the built-in recovery keys on, for three ways a provider can refuse an over-long request without naming it. (1) A max-tokens finish whose output count is negligible: a provider (or pi-ai's own context clamp) that truncates an over-long request answers finish_reason 'length', which the harness reads as an ordinary output cap, so the session answers 'continue' with one token forever. (2) A request refused for its size (HTTP 413, or size wording on a request-rejection code) while every in-tree budget reports headroom, because the harness prices a request in tokens and never in bytes. (3) An unattributed error finish on a prompt whose own counted tokens have reached the window the route advertises: the provider named the reason numerically and in no words, and the upstream usage-based sniff is one conjunct short of this case. Compatible with every prerelease line from 0.1.3-alpha.2 onward (0.1.3/0.1.5/0.1.6).
